sovereign.title: Sovereign infrastructure
sovereign.description: Our products run on bare-metal Kubernetes that we operate ourselves. No vendor lock-in and full data residency. {agpl} of the {total} catalog platforms publish their code under AGPL-3.0; each page states its licence.

humanCreativity.description: Autonomous agents drive ops; human strategists own the call on direction. Concretely: a vCTO partners with you while Selva runs the back-office.

poweredBy.title: Powered by Our Own Stack
poweredBy.subtitle: We eat our own cooking. Every product we build, we use.
poweredBy.description: This website runs on Enclii (our sovereign PaaS) and authenticates with Janua (our identity platform). Cotiza and Forgesight are built alongside our infrastructure by the same team. When we say our tools work in production, we mean it.

openSource.title: Built in the Open
openSource.subtitle: 69 public repositories. We build in the open and contribute to the commons.
openSource.description: From Janua (AGPL-3.0 identity platform) to Yantra4D Commons (36 parametric designs free for anyone to use), we believe open source is how real infrastructure gets built. Our code is our resume.

bitsToAtoms.title: From Bits to Atoms
bitsToAtoms.subtitle: A complete pipeline from sovereign cloud to physical manufacturing.
bitsToAtoms.description: MADFAM's ecosystem connects the entire value chain: sovereign cloud infrastructure (Enclii) → identity and access (Janua) → parametric design (Yantra4D) → manufacturing execution (Pravara MES) → financial intelligence (Dhanam). From software to hardware, from bits to atoms.

research.title: Research & Incubation
research.description: Beyond our core products, MADFAM operates research initiatives in legal-tech, electrochemistry, community logistics, and more. Not every project becomes a product—but every project teaches us something.
